settings.title: Desktop Atlas Driver
settings.text:
The Blacklyte desktop app lets you control all of your Blacklyte lighting devices from your Windows computer. You can synchronize games and screens, set device schedules, and more to create a variety of immersive mood lighting.

The desktop app requires at least Windows 10.0.26100.0.

settings.title: Game Sync
settings.description: Gameplay will be enhanced by mapping in-game events—like hits, kills, and deaths—to dynamic RGB effects, extending the action and excitement into your real-world space for a truly immersive experience.

settings.title: Screen Sync
settings.description: By mirroring on-screen activity to your lighting, your gaming or movie-watching can be elevated to the next level.

settings.title: Rhythm Sync
settings.description: Real-time sync for lights pulse, flow, and color change with your audio. Precise beat analysis enables a seamless fusion of music and lighting for a perfectly synchronized audiovisual experience.

settings.title: Scenes
settings.description: Offers a variety of multi-sensory, immersive atmospheres, such as deep forests, vast oceans, serene meditation, and more.
